summary: Athene Holding Ltd. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for an offering of senior notes due 20__, with aggregate principal amount and interest rate to be determined. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, not guaranteed by Apollo Global Management, and will not be listed on any exchange. The filing is a routine debt securities offering, not a special-situations event. No special-situation categories apply; the registrant is the issuer of the notes.
